patches.reason: Upstream build error: Layout.jsx imports a non-existent lucide-react icon 'XitHub' (search/replace artifact of 'Github'), so vite build fails and the app never renders.
Render a default avatar for an empty round profile image. CSS supplies the visual fallback without changing the seeded identity or saved app state.
Default settings carried a demo signature with a placeholder address; a seed without a settings key received it on first load and every composed message would have carried it.
Composed and replied messages appended a demo signature with a placeholder address to every worker-sent email.

normalizeEvent rebuilt every seeded event from a fixed field list, so fields the UI does not use (status, meetLink) were dropped and the first save wrote the shrunken events back to the shared store for everyone.
The top bar showed a 'Debug API' button linking to the harness state page; workers must not see debug controls. The /go route itself is untouched.
The sidebar footer linked to 'Debug State (/go)'; workers must not see debug controls.

A calendar's colour is used as a CSS class, so a seeded hex like '#039BE5' painted nothing and every calendar in the sidebar read as unchecked while its events were on screen. A hex now colours the box through style; a class name still works as before.

An event's colour is used as a CSS class beside text-white, so a seeded hex painted no background and the month grid showed white text on white. Measured in a guest: 7 of 7 chips had background-color rgba(0,0,0,0) and the screenshot was an empty grid, with 297 of 297 seeded events invisible; fleet-wide 11,731 of 17,465 events are hex-coloured. The same fix already landed in Sidebar.jsx and missed this view.
Preserve seeded calendar IDs; demo-only normalization hid every real company event and rewrote their calendar references.
Preserve seeded event metadata through normalization and ordinary saves.

Upstream loadData() writes the per-sid initial key synchronously before the first-visit check runs, so isRefresh is always true and the app never reads /state; use a per-tab sessionStorage marker to detect a refresh instead.
deepMergeWithDefaults copied every demo document the seed did not name into the seeded documents map, and the next save posted the polluted state over the shared store.
Saves need a hydration flag: nothing may be posted before the shared store has answered.
With no sid the app skipped /state, kept its five demo documents and saved them; the proxy appended its own sid, so the demo landed on the shared store.
A tab becomes writable only once the seeded state is in; a failed or empty /state must not turn the demo data into the shared state.
The save effect ran on the mount render with the demo state, before the /state fetch had settled.
navigate('/document/' + id) dropped ?sid; after a reload of that route the app had no session id and saved its demo state.
The editor's navigate('/') and copy/new document routes dropped ?sid the same way as the document list.

The grid card put each document's entire body into its preview text node. google_docs is in 60 of 60 worlds, so this is the one app whose list page grows with the whole corpus: LA-County's renders 2.5 MB of innerText in an 8.1 MB DOM, which is why its cards are unclickable and why the render gate caught the page still loading. Only the first ~400 characters can ever be shown through line-clamp-6.

The document card is a plain <div onClick> with no role, so the only addressable controls on the list are the clone's own six stock template cards -- 'Blank', 'Resume', 'Letter', 'Project proposal', 'Meeting notes' -- plus 'Template gallery'. Those are exactly the 7 targets the interact gate found and the 7 that timed out, which is why clicks_mostly_work fails for an app that renders 200 of 200 seeded strings. google_docs is in 60 of 60 worlds. role=button with the document's own title names every one of the company's documents and demotes the template gallery, the same fix circleci's nav needed.
